method: tools/parity/oidc-differential.cjs against isolated copies of the API-initialized pinned v2.37.2 fixture and one ephemeral local RS256 provider; 24 Node-versus-Go cases include web session and mobile redirect state checks after ten minutes.
normalization: JWT signatures and random token bytes are not retained; algorithms and claims are compared, normalizing only UUID-valued identifiers and timestamps. Each ID-token nonce is checked against the nonce from that same side authorization flow.
Node and Go use separate copied fixture directories and database files. Only fixture-specific backup paths are normalized in API settings; persisted user fields and session counts remain compared.

JSON object member order is canonicalized for Socket.IO payload comparison because JSON object order is not semantically significant; array order, scalar values, null versus empty, and linked-user raw persisted extraData text remain strict.
limits: The expiry cases verify a web callback after 10 minutes but before the 24-hour session TTL, and mobile redirect-state expiry after 10 minutes, with no intervening requests. The exact 24-hour session boundary, rolling session-touch renewal, exact 10-minute mobile redirect expiry boundary, and other redirect schemes remain open. Logout errors, allDevices, missing/invalid refresh token, provider callback errors, and mobile logout remain unverified.

differences: Go omitted Express weak ETag on res.json-equivalent logout body
Go did not re-emit the signed connect.sid session cookie
Go added Max-Age, HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite attributes absent from upstream clearCookie headers
preFixLogoutMismatch.persistedSessionEffect: Both implementations removed the one refresh session row.

preFixInvalidVerifierMismatch.replay: both return 400 No session; both preserve zero provider-linked users and sessions

preFixWebStateExpiryMismatch.node: 302 redirect to /audiobookshelf/login with tokens; provider-linked user and one session persisted
preFixWebStateExpiryMismatch.go: 302 redirect to /login?error=No%20sign-in%20session; no provider-linked user or session persisted
